Layer 2 · Motive, and the arithmetic

What will it really cost?

The price is the number you negotiate. This is the number you pay. Adjust the assumptions and watch the 140m² threshold and the seller's taxes do their work.

  • Total purchase cost—

The rules behind it

  • Deed tax is 1% up to 140m² for a first or second home, 1.5–2% above that
  • Commercial stock is charged at 3% regardless of area
  • VAT and income tax are the seller's, but are often pushed onto the buyer
  • 140m² is a cliff, not a gradient
